cli.error.auth: {brain}: an ƙi makullin. Duba shi, ko haɗa wata ƙwaƙwalwa.
cli.error.credits: {brain} ya ƙare da kiredit. Ƙara wasu a asusunka, ko zaɓi wata ƙwaƙwalwa.
cli.error.rate_limit: {brain}: akwai cunkoso ko iyakarka ta cika. Jira kaɗan sannan ka sake gwadawa.
cli.error.bad_request: {brain}: ba a karɓi buƙatar ba. Gwada wata sigar wannan ƙwaƙwalwa.
cli.error.not_found: {brain}: ba a sami wannan siga ba. Zaɓi wata.
cli.error.server: {brain}: akwai matsala. Sake gwadawa nan da ɗan lokaci.
cli.error.bad_response: {brain}: amsar da aka aiko ba ta karantuwa. Sake gwadawa.
cli.error.unknown: Wani abu ya ɓaci. Sake gwadawa.
cli.folder: Faɗi fayil ɗin ajiya da Daidaitawa ke kiyayewa: --folder <fayil ɗin ajiya>.
cli.notSync: {folder} ba fayil ɗin ajiya ne da Daidaitawa ke kiyayewa ba. Ba da wanda aka zaɓa a Saituna › Bayananka.
cli.lost: Wannan tattaunawa ba ta cikin {folder} kuma.
cli.noBrain: Babu ƙwaƙwalwar da za ta iya amsawa tukuna. Saka makullinta a cikin muhalli (environment), kamar ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ko shiga Claude Code.
cli.help.acp: {name} a cikin editanka, a kan fayil ɗin ajiya da Daidaitawa ke kiyayewa.
cli.help.brain: --brain na zaɓar ƙwaƙwalwa, kamar anthropic, openrouter ko claudecode; makullinta na zuwa daga muhalli.
cli.help.gateway: Ƙofar shiga, don ayyukan da mai bincike ba zai iya isa gare su ba, kamar Gmail ko Slack.
cli.gateway.origin: Faɗi adireshin da kake buɗewa a mai bincike, kamar https://{domain}: --origin <adireshi>.
cli.gateway.ready: Ƙofar shiga na amsawa a {address}. Saka ta a Saituna › Haɗe-haɗe.
